security.csp: default-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:*; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' http://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data: blob: http://127.0.0.1:* asset: http://asset.localhost; font-src 'self' data: http://127.0.0.1:*; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:*; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: Native desktop shell for the Zyvor QA Agent Mission Control dashboard
bundle.longDescription: Zyvor QA Agent Desktop wraps `zyvor-qa serve` in a native macOS window — no browser tab needed. All test execution, reporting, and dashboard functionality is unchanged; this is a thin shell, not a reimplementation.
